data.name: Veggie Vendetta
data.detailed_description:
Veggie Vendetta is a dynamic action roguelike where you step into the peel of fruits and vegetables fighting for survival against hordes of insatiable bugs. Your mission is to survive wave after wave of enemies, collect coins and diamonds, and build an increasingly powerful arsenal.

In the Shop:

  • Buy and Upgrade: Choose new weapons and strengthen your existing ones to maximize your firepower.

  • Manage Currency: Spend coins and diamonds dropped by enemies to grow in strength.

  • Reroll Offers: If the current shop items don't fit your strategy, refresh the list (reroll) for a chance to find something better.

Key Features:

  • Diverse Characters: Each fruit and vegetable comes with unique special abilities that fundamentally change your combat style.

  • Wave-Based System: Every stage brings a new challenge—you’ll need sharp reflexes to avoid being overwhelmed.

  • Build Crafting: Combine weapons and items to create devastating attack synergies.

If you fall in battle, you must start from the beginning, but with every run, you gain a deeper understanding of the mechanics and learn how to master the shop's economy.

data.short_description: Veggie Vendetta is an intense action roguelike (bullet heaven). Play as fruits and vegetables, fend off hordes of bugs, and manage your arsenal. Buy new weapons, upgrade them, and reroll shop offers to create a devastating build and survive!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz (Dual Core)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (DirectX 10/11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent (2.5 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM (e.g., Nvidia GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Integrated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or newer

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
